fixed.summary: A game with a UI fails its cook, naming the image and the styles directory, when that directory lacks one of the default pack's shapes (an engine's styles/ older than og, or an OG_STYLES_DIR without shared/shapes/). Before, it cooked without them and every `nine-disc`, `nine-ring`, `nine-tile` and `nine-*-cut` drew nothing at run time, warning only there. Fix: point OG_STYLES_DIR at the engine's own styles, or reinstall the engine package.
